'''Ma Zuguang''' ({{zh|s=马祖光|t=馬祖光}}; 1928–2003) was a Chinese physicist. He is an expert in [[optoelectronics|optoelectronic technology]] and professor of [[Harbin Institute of Technology]] (HIT). Ma founded two disciplines at HIT, [[nuclear physics]] and [[laser|laser technology]]. He also founded the [[Tunable laser|Tunable Laser]] Laboratory, a state-level key laboratory. He was an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{cite web|title=光之骄子——马祖光|url=http://hlj.ifeng.com/culture/figure/detail_2014_08/12/2748725_0.shtml|language=zh|publisher=ifeng.com|date=2014-08-12|accessdate=2019-11-29}}</ref>

Ma graduated from Department of Physics, [[Shandong University]] in [[Qingdao]] in 1950.<ref>{{cite web|title=马祖光院士大事年表|url=http://www.people.com.cn/GB/jiaoyu/8216/37216/37437/2767695.html|language=zh|accessdate=2019-11-29}}</ref> He later gained [[Postgraduate education|postgraduate degree]] from [[Harbin Institute of Technology]] and worked for HIT after graduation.

==Personal life==
Ma and his wife Sun Yuezhen were classmates at [[Shandong University]]. They both became faculty members of [[Harbin Institute of Technology]].
